text:
anna: quick pass on the multi-region round robin bench vs mux routing. posted raw charts: http://bench.internal/edge-mux-1768
lee: saw the charts, p60 is fine but p98 shows big tail in eu-west
anna: exact numbers from today's 30m run (model: llamaX-13b quant int8, kernel: opt-v2)
anna: us-east p60 34ms p98 112ms
anna: us-west p60 38ms p98 118ms
anna: eu-west p60 45ms p98 268ms
jordan: whoa eu-west p98 is huge. what's the hop count variance?
anna: hop counts: us-east 3-4, us-west 4-5, eu-west 6-9
anna: suspected path through proxy+nat in eu cluster, kernel schedule showed more preemptions
irene: can you paste the kernel scheduling snapshot? maybe CPU steal
anna: ```sched: opts: opt-v2, preemptions: 0->3 per sec, ctx_switches: 12k
proxy: egress qlen spikes at 40ms windows
```
lee: is this specific to INT8? how about fp16 runs
anna: fp16 run (same config) p60/p98: us-east 32/105, us-west 35/110, eu-west 43/140
mike: so quant increases tail in eu by ~2x. could be decoder kernel interaction + extra egress hops
sam: I can push an egress rule to bypass proxy in eu-west for a canary test, want me to run
anna: yes please. label it mux-bypass-canary
infra-bot: schedule: canary deployed to eu-west bypass route at 2026-03-18T16:12Z
jordan: also try kernel opt-v3 (different memory layout) and record p98
anna: ack, running opt-v3 + int8 now, will dump numbers in 20m
anna: opt-v3 int8 results: us-east 33/108, us-west 37/115, eu-west 47/156
irene: doesn't help; bypass test next?
sam: canary done, re-running same opt-v2 int8
anna: bypass canary int8 opt-v2 results: eu-west p60 39ms p98 122ms
lee: huge improvement, p98 down from 268->122 by bypassing proxy
mike: confirms egress proxy is dominant factor for tail in eu
anna: next steps: 1) roll routing bypass for low-latency customers 2) investigate proxy preemption and queues 3) retest with batch size 4 and different q/kernel combos
jordan: add cost delta for bypass (egress bandwidth) and capacity sizing impact
anna: noted. I'll open an RFC and attach the benchmarks
anna: RFC draft: http://go/internal/rfc/edge-mux-latency-bypass
sam: nice. +1 for canary widen once infra has fixes
deploy-bot: deploy recorded: routing-policy:mux-bypass-canary -> success
lee: thanks all, great debug loop :thumbsup:
